description: Land Title Settlement Department - Giripendegama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and identities, nature of title, and any encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
